title: Flipping a coordinate reverses full parity
statement: For every natural number $n$, every Boolean-cube input $x$, and every coordinate $i$, flipping coordinate $i$ reverses the full parity: the parity over all $n$ coordinates at the flipped input is the negative of its value at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is an input in the Boolean cube of dimension $n$
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
